counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0255 to 0.001 (single field change); no collision occurs within 9 steps window so energy stays ~3316J and energy_bound passes.

explanation: Energy jumps from 3125J at step 8 (no contact) to 14969J at step 9 (first body-body contact, gap 0.046), exceeding limit 3652J with zero controller work. Both bodies have high restitution (0.9,1.0) and large dt triggers 40+ substeps, indicating collision response injects energy. Reducing dt to 0.001 avoids violation while keeping all bodies identical, confirming numerical/excessive restitution handling under large substeps.
vision_note: From steps 6 to 8 two isolated blue circular bodies drift closer together while descending. At step 9 they make first contact and visibly overlap/touch, marking a body-body collision with no walls or controller body in view.
